summary_en: Sankosyoji to delist from TOKYO PRO Market and transfer 100% of shares to Sadojima Co., becoming a wholly owned subsidiary. Delisting application filed June 2, 2026; delisting effective June 30, 2026. Share transfer effective June 30, 2026. Prior written consent from shareholders holding 2/3+ of voting rights obtained; shareholder meeting special resolution waived.
summary_jp: 三興商事がTOKYO PRO Marketから上場廃止、佐渡島へ全株式譲渡し完全子会社化。上場廃止申請日2026年6月2日、上場廃止予定日2026年6月30日。議決権3分の2以上の株主から事前同意取得。
